response.answer: Deadline alone does not decide this. Recorded in this system: each order’s stage (an order at packing is one stage from done), due date, last activity and the queue’s best-case finish. Not recorded: dispatch booking, yarn or material status. The rule: an order already packed with dispatch secured is low risk even if due tomorrow; an order five days out with a missing input is the one to escalate, because the procurement lead time sits on its critical path.
